owner_constraints: Selected mesh, proportions, UVs, pixel pattern and palette are immutable
No visible breathing/pumping abdomen and no perpetual idle fidgeting
Movement should reflect tarantula locomotion rather than mammalian breathing

sources.finding: Gas exchange through book lungs; no diaphragm-driven inhalation/exhalation. Do not animate mammalian-looking body expansion.

sources.kind: Primary experimental study abstract, Uddin and Arbuckle, Arachnology 20(1)
sources.finding: Pterinochilus murinus defensive responses include fleeing, rearing and biting. Enclosure context changes which response appears; do not equate orange colour with permanent attacking or restlessness.

sources.kind: Primary taxonomic and natural-history paper, West et al. 2008
sources.finding: Ephebopus is generally fossorial. Genus-level natural history supports retreat-oriented interpretation; it does not support the fictional ranged-spit ability.

sources.kind: Primary locomotion study abstract on juvenile P. murinus
sources.finding: Leg roles are differentiated: rear pair mainly propulsive, front pairs also stabilize/explore, third pair stabilizes. Avoid making every leg a synchronized decorative oscillator.

sources.kind: Primary kinematic study, Eupalaestrus weijenberghi, a different theraphosid species
sources.finding: Walking and slopes studied; anterior and posterior limb functions differ. Cross-species inspiration only, not a measured gait of E. cyanognathus.

sources.kind: Primary field natural-history study, Zamani and West 2026, Ecology and Evolution, DOI 10.1002/ece3.73329
sources.finding: E. cyanognathus juveniles use arboreal retreats; later stages move to ground burrows. Life stage matters. This is background for behaviour design; the current game does not simulate life-stage shifts.

application.rest: Use the authored fixed rest pose; remove perpetual breathing IDLE playback.
application.locomotion: Retain existing native MOVE channels on their unchanged pivots; drive them from actual native limb swing, including vertical surface travel.
application.sound: No idle monster chatter; footsteps and event sounds attenuated. No new sound assets.
application.combat: Existing fantasy roles, attack timings, damage, targeting, navigation and hitboxes remain intact.
limitations: Lurker LS04 species is not identified in its owner photo-reference metadata; no specific species identity is invented.
No burrow construction, mating behaviour or life-stage simulation is claimed.
No claim of universal silence: some tarantulas can produce defensive sounds, unlike a permanent ambient loop.
